word_reference.source_review: Actual dashboard-to-generic-list mismatch; not a cosmetic card redesign

finding: Dashboard mode=mine scopes portfolio ownership; the old generic action-list shortcut mine=true scopes action ownership. Delegated work on a current portfolio can contribute to a counter but disappear from its linked list.
The old actions_today card supplied no due-day predicate and at_risk supplied no risk predicate. Opening those lists did not reproduce the counters.
Native MetricDrilldown already applied the same scoped portfolio/source predicates but had no overdue_returns case; native Action rows linked to generic customer health instead of their exact action.
implemented: Existing five summary cards retain placement/colors and now open a reusable Dialog containing the installed native MetricDrilldownPanel. Dashboard and popup share the exact existing portfolio/segment parameters. Original portfolio, health and action pages/editors remain present. No changed portfolio-versus-action ownership rules.

Actual0 counters are inspectable; unavailable measurements are disabled and remain distinct from0. Existing native table/paging/source links reused, with wrapping/min-width fixes for dialog content. No new business data store.

Missing overdue_returns native source uses active authorized actions and actual expired return_at, matching the counter even while SLA is paused. It displays that actual reassessment timestamp rather than an unrelated future deadline.

Every native Action metric row now opens its exact action_id in the current account. mine=false prevents an unrelated personal owner filter from hiding delegated work; current native record access remains authoritative.

Popup aborts/clears on identity/filter changes and denial, reloads the enclosing scope on403/404, handles unavailable data and bounded disappearing-page recovery. Workspace also observes role/grant changes before retaining source popups. No source write or new API endpoint.
